The foredeck is flush at the sheer, fz(u) = station(u).kz + station(u).dep - 0.012 (consoleIsoRig.js:272), cut inboard of the rail cap by fw(u) = station(u).ws - TH*1.5 - 0.014 (:273), bulkhead at FORE_U = 0.80 (:271). So the cleat rides 0.070 - 0.012 = 0.058 m higher than the pass-1 value: z 0.989 -> 1.047, measured on the landed rig. x and y are unaffected — bow_1 is on the centreline, so the inboard cut does not touch it. The repo README's 'console foredeck DROP = 0.07' derivation trap is RETIRED for this hull.
